Sakura Bakushin O takes on the Sprinters 
Stakes for the second time.

She called Nishino Flower to the waiting 
room and made a ringing declaration of 
victory, vowing that she would definitely 
win this race!

Two runners, each brimming with confidence 
in their speed. On a fated...? stage, the 
two clash fair and square!
